title: Kore.ai Artemis Agent Platform Launch
text: On May 21, 2026 Kore.ai launched Artemis edition of its Agent Platform — an AI-programmable, AI-native foundation for building, governing, and optimizing enterprise agents, systems, and workflows. Initial launch on Microsoft Azure with broader cloud availability planned. Three core innovations: Agent Blueprint Language (ABL) for compiled validated agent definitions; Arch for AI-driven agent design; Dual-Brain architecture balancing autonomous reasoning with deterministic rule-based execution. Positioning: deploy production-ready multiagent systems in days not months with governance, observability, and operational control enforced before agents go live. Target: regulated industries (banking, healthcare, insurance) where scale, compliance, and reliability are non-negotiable. Analyst recognition: Gartner MQ Leader for Enterprise Conversational AI (highest Ability to Execute per company); Forrester Wave Leader for Cognitive Search; Everest Group Leader in Agentic AI Products PEAK Matrix 2026. Competitive bet: neutral model-agnostic layer vs hyperscaler lock-in (Microsoft, Salesforce, ServiceNow). Integration: 40+ channels, 300+ enterprise integrations, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365, Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Teams via Azure Bot Framework. CEO Raj Koneru frames enterprise AI third wave as governance + observability + trust at scale.
